assumptions: T2 (Binance proxy) scope = 12/17 coins (top-12 rule was larger); remaining 5 coin(s) use T1 (if recent) or T3 only. Computed from the wallet's full raw history (not the E_min-pushed scored window) since it feeds price prefetch.

L_t (leader daily equity for proportional sizing, v0.4 §1.2) = linear interpolation of portfolio.allTime.accountValueHistory to each day's 00:00 UTC boundary — the leader's REAL reported equity, NOT netted against deposits/withdrawals (v0.3's netting was reverted; the leader sizes positions against what they actually have). Falls back to the leader's own fills-based MTM curve on 2/163 day(s) of the full raw history outside accountValueHistory's covered range.

D1-c loss(e) = qty*(p_recon - p_exec) + (catch-up slippage + catch-up fee), qty signed (v0.4 sign fix vs v0.3, which had the first term negated). loss(e) can be negative (a missed trade followed by a favorable price move before catch-up is a net benefit). Does not add back the fee/slippage the original (now-skipped) t+δ trade would have paid — the formula as given only adds the catch-up leg's own friction, so loss(e) is the INCREMENTAL cost of deferring this one trade, not a full swap-accounting of both legs.
